paragraphs.text: Stone is an obsolete token creature type for creatures that were turned to stone and acted as a wall . In general, stone is a solid mass of minerals. It later became an artifact type .

Stone debuted as a creature type in Mirage on tokens created by the Basalt Golem artifact creature . It created a Stone token that was a 0/2 colorless artifact creature that also counted as a Wall . This represents it turning the creatures into stone statues of themselves. The "counts as a Wall" was due to Walls having their own rules at that time before Defender being introduced. With the digital release of Mirage for Magic Online , it was given errata to just be Wall tokens instead. The type was removed from the Comprehensive Rules with the release of Ravnica: City of Guilds . The type was never printed on any card or token, only mentioned in the original printing of Basalt Golem and within the comprehensive rules as a type.

Other than its original use, most references to stone in creatures are on golems and gargoyles , which are often made of stone, while Gorgons and Basilisks are known to turn other creatures to stone. Notable characters that reference stone are Alpharael , who is called Stonechosen, while Damia is known as the "Sage of Stone", and Stonebrow is called the "Face of Stone". On Rath , many creatures are made of flowstone .
In Universes Beyond , Denethor from Lord of the Rings is referred to as the "Stone Seer" while Tombstone is a Marvel villain .
